Bottom stop of the blood button's gradient.

name: Grimoire

colors.u: The ground behind everything: page background, gutters, the area outside the book. Body copy in `ink` and `ink-muted` reads on it in both themes.
Default reading surface (leather by night, vellum by day). Cards that sit flush, panels, the body of a page.
Lifted objects: cards, modals, toasts, menus, inputs. Pair with `shadow-raised` or `shadow-float`.
Wells and tracks: input fields at rest, progress tracks, toggle tracks, code. Use `ink` or `ink-muted` on it, never `ink-faint` in vellum.
Quiet hairlines: dividers inside cards, table rules, the inner rule of the double border. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.
Gilded rule: control borders, card frames, the outer edge of the double border. Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised as a control edge in both themes (grimoire 3.5:1 on raised).
Primary text and icons on every surface and soft status fill.
Secondary text, helper text, metadata, inactive tabs. On every surface.
Placeholders and tertiary captions on surface, surface-raised and surface-void. Not on surface-sunken in vellum (4.2:1).
The brand's blood-ink. Fill for primary buttons, the active tab ribbon, toggle-on tracks, wax seals. Text on it is `on-crimson`.
Hover and pressed fill of crimson elements, and the hot core of ember particles.
Crimson as text or icon: drop caps, emphasized links, required markers, on any surface.
Text and icons on `crimson` and `crimson-bright` fills.
Gold leaf as a fill or stroke: filigree corners, sigils, toggle knobs, progress glints, gilt dividers. Text on a gold fill is `on-gold`.
Highlights only: the shimmer sweep, the hot edge of a burning toast, sparkle in a cast effect. Never text.
Gold as text: eyebrows, inscriptions, active labels, links in body copy, on surface and surface-raised.
Text and icons on `gold` fills.
Keyboard focus. A solid 2px ring with a 2px gap in the surface colour; at least 4:1 on every surface in both themes.
Verdigris. Text and icons for a spell that took: confirmations, completed steps. Always paired with a word or icon. On surfaces and `success-soft`.
Background of success alerts and toasts.
Amber. Text and icons for caution. Always paired with a word or icon. On surfaces and `warning-soft`.
Background of warning alerts and toasts.
Hexfire. Errors and destructive outcomes; distinct from brand crimson by hue toward orange and by its icon. On surface, surface-raised and `danger-soft`.
Background of error alerts, toasts and invalid inputs.
Astral blue. Text and icons for neutral notices and tips. On surfaces and `info-soft`.
Background of info alerts and toasts.
Shaded side of gold metal: the lower edge of corner mounts and button finials. Never text.
The hard shadow a metal corner mount or a lifted page casts onto the paper.
Bright core of a crackling arc of power (button charge, casts, the rune wall).
The thin glow around an arc's core. Only ever drawn around arcs, never as a halo behind text.
Resting runes on the rune wall and rune strips, drawn at partial strength.
A rune at the moment it flares, or where an arc touches it.
Seams between the carved blocks of the rune wall.
The faint arcane diagram printed into the page background.
Soft light around gold arcs and the toast's burning edge. Never a halo behind text or controls.
Soft light around danger arcs on failed casts and the toast's burning edge.
Ageing on the page: the soft stains in the body background and empty states.
Dims the page behind a modal.

name: Obsidian

colors.u: Page background. Pure black in dark (AMOLED) — never tint it. Everything else sits on top.
Cards, panels, sidebar, table body. The first step up from bg.
Raised inside a card: inputs, secondary buttons, table header, hover on surface-1.
Pressed/active fills, hover on surface-2, progress tracks.
Hairline dividers: table rows, card edges where grey steps aren't enough, input outlines.
Hovered input outlines, emphasised dividers. Meets 3:1 against bg only in light; decorative in dark.
Primary text and numbers on bg, surface-1, surface-2, surface-3.
Secondary text, labels, table headers on bg and every surface.
Tertiary text: timestamps, hints, units, placeholders. Legible on bg and every surface; don't go lighter.
Obsidian's one hue: primary buttons, active nav, selected tabs, links, chart series 1. Text in accent reads on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.
Hover state of accent fills and links.
Tinted fill behind active nav items, selected rows, accent badges. Put accent or text on it, never on-accent.
Text and icons on an accent or accent-hover fill.
Keyboard focus: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. Accent clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes.
Healthy / online / positive delta. Text and dots on bg and every surface. Always paired with a word.
Fill behind success badges.
Degraded / approaching limit. Text and dots on bg and every surface. Always paired with a word.
Fill behind warning badges.
Error / offline / negative delta / destructive buttons. Text on bg and every surface. Always paired with a word.
Fill behind danger badges and the danger button.
Chart series 1 — the series that matters most.
Chart series 2.
Chart series 3.
Chart series 4.
Chart series 5. Beyond five series, group the rest as 'Other' in text-subtle.

name: Tactile

colors.u: The one material. Page background AND the fill of every raised or inset element — neumorphism only works when objects are extruded from the same color as the ground.
Floor of inset wells: text fields, switch tracks, progress tracks. A half-step darker so a well reads as a well even where shadows are lost (high-contrast mode, print, screenshots).
The light-side shadow color (top-left). Only used inside shadow tokens; never as a fill.
The dark-side shadow color (bottom-right). Only used inside shadow tokens; never as a fill.
Primary text and icons on surface (10.9:1 light, 11.8:1 dark).
Secondary text, labels, captions on surface or surface-sunken (≥4.8:1 in both themes).
Disabled text, placeholder hints, decorative glyphs. 3:1 — never for content a person must read to proceed.
Decorative 1px rim on raised elements; softens the silhouette. Not a boundary on its own.
The accessible boundary (3:1 on surface): rims of text fields, switch tracks and any control whose shape would otherwise be told only by shadow.
The single hue. Primary action fill, 'on' state of switches, slider fill, selected segment text. One accent-filled control per view.
Text and icons on accent (6.1:1 light, 9.4:1 dark).
Keyboard focus ring: 2px outline, 3px offset. Always visible — shadows never carry focus.
Error text and the rim of an invalid field (≥5.4:1). Paired with an icon or message, never color alone.
Confirmation text and completed-progress states (≥5.4:1).
Active-glow ink, violet tone: label, rim and halo of a lit Pad or toggled IconButton. ≥5:1 on its own fill, including the glow hotspot.
Active-glow body, violet tone: the tinted fill a lit Pad lights up with.
Active-glow ink, blue tone.
Active-glow body, blue tone.
Active-glow ink, teal tone.
Active-glow body, teal tone.
Active-glow ink, yellow tone.
Active-glow body, yellow tone.
Active-glow ink, green tone. Also the default glow for navigation icons (the lit arrow on a D-pad).
Active-glow body, green tone.
